title: DC-area forecast: Warm and a bit breezy today; cooler, wetter pattern on the horizon
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Sunshine mixes with clouds. Muggy morning 70s head to afternoon highs mainly in the low to mid-80s. A breeze from the north is noticeable at times.

What's next? Pleasant enough Saturday, despite the potential for some more clouds at times. Confidence is growing in a multi-day stretch with periods of showers and thunderstorms — along with a cooldown — late Sunday into much of next week.

Today's daily digit — 6/10: Humidity may be slow to drop, but at least we're eventually headed in the right direction. A warm day with a mix of clouds and sun, plus only an isolated shower. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Friday): Warm with a mix of sun and clouds. Highs are mainly in the low to mid-80s. A wind from the north around 10 mph may gust near 20 mph. There's an outside chance of a brief shower, especially in the afternoon. Humidity is slowly to drop, with dew points near 70 early and closer to the mid-60s by late afternoon. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Partly cloudy, with a light but steady breeze from the north-northeast. Lower humidity allows temperatures to fall to lows near 60 to the mid-60s. A brief shower is possible late night or nearer dawn. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Saturday: Cooler, less humid air is briefly in town. Highs reach the mid-70s to near 80, with dew points near 60. The cloud forecast is a bit uncertain, so skies could range from partly sunny to mostly cloudy. Confidence: Medium

Saturday night: Humidity increases again under mostly cloudy skies. A couple showers could roam the region. Lows are in the 60s for most of us and near 70 in downtown DC. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Cloudier than not and breezy, with a couple brief showers possible early. The bulk of the shower and storm chances should wait until late afternoon or evening. It's not especially warm but fairly humid, with highs near 80 to the mid-80s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: Showers and a couple of thunderstorms are likely. Some rain may be moderate to heavy. Quite humid, with lows in the 60s most places to near 70 in DC. Confidence: Medium

Mostly cloudy Monday with showers possible at times, especially later in the day. Cooler starts filtering in, with temperatures potentially holding in the 70s. Confidence: Low-Medium

A more pronounced cooldown arrives Tuesday with showers, a few storms, and even periods of steadier rain possible. Highs may only hover in the 60s to around 70, which would be among the coolest days since spring. Confidence: Medium

The unsettled, cool pattern looks to continue into Wednesday and Thursday, with highs mainly in the 60s to near 70 and additional chances for showers and a stray thunderstorm. Slow improvement is possible by the end of the week. Confidence: Medium

Hurricane Isabel

Isabel in 2003 brought damaging winds, widespread power outages, and significant flooding along the Potomac and Chesapeake Bay.
